summary: Russian forces have advanced to within four kilometers of Sloviansk and breached the first defensive line between Sloviansk and Kramatorsk, with street fighting reported in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka. Overnight, Russia launched massive drone and missile strikes across Ukraine, hitting Kyiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, and Sumy regions, killing at least one civilian and wounding dozens. The Kherson thermal power plant was completely destroyed by four aerial bombs, leaving the city without heating for an extended period.
key_points: Russian troops are within 4 km of Sloviansk and have breached Ukrainian defenses near Kramatorsk, per Gerasimov. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32790)
Overnight Russian drone and missile attacks struck multiple Ukrainian regions, causing casualties and infrastructure damage. (Source: @UkraineNow/83715)
Kherson TPP suffered critical damage from four aerial bombs, eliminating heating for much of the city. (Source: @UkraineNow/83723)
Russian air defenses claimed 39 Ukrainian UAVs shot down over Russian regions and Black/Azov seas. (Source: @tass_agency/392343)
Ukrainian drones attacked an Ozon warehouse in Blagoveshchensk, Bashkortostan, the second such strike since August 22. (Source: @UkraineNow/83718)
Three Ukrainian drones attacked a Turkish vessel in the Black Sea, causing a fire and injuring five crew members. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32798)
GUR reports Russia may have used upgraded Iskander-1000 ballistic missiles for the first time. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32799)
Italy plans a secret €3 billion military aid package including four SAMP/T NG batteries and seven long-range radars. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32784)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces have advanced to within four kilometers of Sloviansk and breached the first defensive line between Sloviansk and Kramatorsk, with street fighting reported in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka. Overnight, Russia launched massive drone and missile strikes across Ukraine, hitting Kyiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, and Sumy regions, killing at least one civilian and wounding dozens. The Kherson thermal power plant was completely destroyed by four aerial bombs, leaving the city without heating for an extended period.

points: Ukrainian air defense engaged reactive Shahed-type UAVs over Kyiv, Brovary, Vyshneve, Boyarka, Boryspil, and Velyka Dymerka throughout the night of 27-28 August, with debris falling in Podilskyi and Shevchenkivskyi districts and a strike on the Epicentr mall in Boryspil. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71496, @mon1tor_ua/71497, @mon1tor_ua/71507, @mon1tor_ua/71479, @kpszsu/74905, @kpszsu/74907)

In Odesa region, infrastructure, an educational institution, and a high-rise building were damaged; in Zaporizhzhia at least three people were wounded and buildings damaged; in Kryvyi Rih two wounded and an industrial enterprise targeted; in Kharkiv a UAV hit a high-rise balcony; in Sumy region a 66-year-old woman was killed and four others injured by a house strike. (Source: @UkraineNow/83715)

Kherson Oblast authorities recommend evacuation as the city may remain without electricity and heat for a prolonged period after Russian strikes completely destroyed all heat-generating equipment at the Kherson TPP. (Source: @UkraineNow/83733)
Ukrainian drones struck an Ozon warehouse in Blagoveshchensk, Bashkortostan, the second attack on the company's infrastructure since 22 August. (Source: @UkraineNow/83718)
Military recruitment officers stormed a warehouse in Odesa attempting to mobilize a man, highlighting domestic mobilization pressures. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32791)

Italy is preparing a secret €3 billion military aid package for Ukraine, potentially including four SAMP/T NG air defense batteries and seven long-range radars, financed by a €90 billion loan. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32784)
GUR head Kyrylo Budanov is operationally addressing veterans' issues at the highest leadership level, per Human Rights Ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets. (Source: @UkraineNow/83725)

Russian General Staff Chief Valery Gerasimov stated Russian troops advanced to within 4 km of Sloviansk's eastern outskirts, with the 'Southern' group breaching the first defensive line between Sloviansk and Kramatorsk and engaging in street fighting in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32790)
Advanced Russian units are conducting combat on an airfield territory 3 km from Kramatorsk's outskirts. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32790)
Russian Ministry of Defense claimed air defenses destroyed 39 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions and the Black and Azov seas in a single day. (Source: @tass_agency/392343)

Russian forces launched repeated strikes on Kherson TPP, dropping four aerial bombs in one attack, causing critical damage to the facility that supplied heat to much of Kherson. (Source: @UkraineNow/83723)
Five missiles struck Zaporizhstal metallurgical plant in the same location as an 11 August attack that killed workers, severely damaging Ukraine's metallurgy capacity. (Source: @UkraineNow/83719)

Russian officials, including Lavrov, dismissed Western statements about 'Anchorage funerals' and Trump expressed confidence Russia will not attack NATO territory. (Source: @tass_agency/392362, @tass_agency/392342)
Russia may have employed upgraded Iskander-1000 ballistic missiles for the first time, posing a greater threat than the baseline Iskander-M, according to Ukrainian GUR. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32799)
Enemy forces advanced in Chasiv Yar per DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23783)
Russian 'Southern' group units breached the first line of defense of the Ukrainian fortified area between Sloviansk and Kramatorsk in certain sectors. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32790)
Street fighting is ongoing in the areas of Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka near Sloviansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32790)
Advanced Russian units are engaged in combat on the territory of an airfield located three kilometers from the outskirts of Kramatorsk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32790)
Russian troops have advanced to within four kilometers of the eastern outskirts of Sloviansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32790)

Reactive Shahed UAVs targeted Kyiv region locations including Vyshneve, Brovary, Boyarka, Boryspil, and Velyka Dymerka from northern and western directions throughout the night. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71496, @mon1tor_ua/71497, @mon1tor_ua/71507, @mon1tor_ua/71479, @kpszsu/74905, @kpszsu/74907)

Multiple air raid alerts sounded in Kyiv at 21:27 (27 Aug), 23:55 (27 Aug), 02:28, 03:32, 03:49 (28 Aug) with all-clear at 03:47 and 04:00 (28 Aug). (Source: @eRadarrua/107735, @eRadarrua/107769, @eRadarrua/107809, @eRadarrua/107812, @eRadarrua/107814, @eRadarrua/107813, @eRadarrua/107815)

Reactive UAVs detected from Vinnytsia region toward Zhytomyr region on northern course; from Chernihiv region (Kosachivka, new from Bryansk) toward Slavutych; from Poltava and Cherkasy regions toward Yahotyn and Pereiaslav. (Source: @kpszsu/74884, @eRadarrua/107758, @eRadarrua/107780, @eRadarrua/107808)

Two reactive Shaheds launched toward Kharkiv from the south; additional reactive UAVs on Kharkiv region moving toward the city and east, and on northwest heading. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71476, @kpszsu/74894)
Reactive UAVs observed in Sumy region (strike UAV group) and Dnipropetrovsk region (reactive group). (Source: @eRadarrua/107755)
Groups of strike UAVs detected west of Ochakiv on northern course; from Black Sea toward Belgorod-Dnestrovsky; in Tatarbunary district on western course. (Source: @kpszsu/74888)
Reactive UAVs targeting Odesa and Mykolaiv regions from the sea; reactive UAV on course to southern Mykolaiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/74895, @kpszsu/74919)
Three Ukrainian drones attacked the Turkish vessel Lider Bordo Mavi in the Black Sea en route from Samsun to Tuapse, causing a fire and injuring five crew members. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32798)
Kherson TPP completely destroyed by four aerial bombs, eliminating heating for a significant portion of Kherson's residential buildings. (Source: @UkraineNow/83723, @UkraineNow/83733)
Zaporizhstal hit by five missiles in the same location as the 11 August strike, causing extremely serious consequences for Ukrainian metallurgy. (Source: @UkraineNow/83719)
Reactive Shahed from Black Sea waters toward Pivdenne, Odesa region; reactive UAV from Dnipropetrovsk region to Poltava region; from Donbas to Pavlohrad district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71510)
Two new reactive Shaheds reported on Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71512)

sections.threat_assessment: The Russian breach near Sloviansk-Kramatorsk represents a significant operational advance threatening the last major Ukrainian stronghold in Donetsk Oblast. Simultaneous mass drone attacks across northern, central, and southern Ukraine indicate Russia's capacity for sustained long-range strike campaigns targeting both military infrastructure and civilian energy systems. The destruction of Kherson TPP ahead of winter suggests a deliberate strategy to render frontline cities uninhabitable. The possible introduction of Iskander-1000 missiles would complicate Ukrainian air defense calculations. Ukrainian strikes on Russian rear logistics (Ozon) and Black Sea shipping demonstrate expanding reach but risk escalation with third parties (Turkey).
sections.regional_response: Italy's covert €3 billion aid package with advanced SAMP/T NG systems signals deepening European commitment despite political hesitancy. CIA Director Ratcliffe's Moscow visit to warn against Baltic escalation and demand cessation of Iranian support reflects U.S. diplomatic pressure on Russia's peripheral ambitions. Trump's dismissal of NATO threat and praise for CIA-Naryshkin contacts suggest potential shifts in U.S. intelligence coordination. Turkey's vessel attack may prompt Ankara to reassess Black Sea security posture. The EU's acknowledged energy dependency crisis (von der Leyen) underscores long-term strategic vulnerability.
sections.intelligence_notes: The density of reactive Shahed launches from multiple vectors (Donbas, Dnipropetrovsk, Black Sea, Russian border regions) indicates diversified launch platforms and improved Russian drone logistics. Real-time tracking via @mon1tor_ua, @kpszsu, and @eRadarrua shows Ukrainian open-source intelligence networks providing granular air threat awareness. Gerasimov's public operational details (4 km to Sloviansk, airfield fights) are unusual for Russian officials and may serve psychological or signaling purposes. The Kherson TPP destruction aligns with Russian 'energy denial' tactics observed since 2022. Ukrainian mobilization incidents (Odesa warehouse) reflect manpower strains.
